evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: owned vs. rented intelligence, matched noun-adjective structure on both sides.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Perspective spoken of AS an asset — a thing kept, owned, held — not mere vividness but a reclassification of an abstract concept as a tangible possession.
